title: After the Japanese Derby: Positive Words

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon declares Rice Shower as her biggest threat at the Kikuka Sho and challenges her publicly, causing the crowd to go wild!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Matikanetannhauser expresses her disappointment at the post-race press conference, but still shows enthusiasm for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her optimism at the press conference touches the hearts of viewers. As with every other race, Matikanetannhauser is heading to the Kikuka Sho with the intent to win.
